extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral researchers and early-career biological/biomedical scientists seeking the Hanna H. Gray Fellowship (HHMI) and related Freeman Hrabowski Scholars opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Page describing the Hanna H. Gray Fellows Program purpose, eligibility requirements, and program structure for postdoctoral researchers in the biological and biomedical sciences. It explains who may apply, required commitments, and how the program links with the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program beginning in 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program purpose / selection priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hanna H. Gray Fellows Program is a transformational award for early career researchers who show exceptional promise of becoming outstanding leaders in academic science, making foundational discoveries while building an inclusive scientific culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Through successful careers, Hanna Gray Fellows will move science forward and will recruit, mentor, and inspire the next generation of scientists from all backgrounds. Fellows receive funding for postdoctoral training and during early years as independent faculty, and join the multigenerational HHMI community to learn how to build healthy research environments that are creative, bold, inclusive, and effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible fields / research area
rubrics_metrics.description: You are eligible to apply if you are a basic science researcher or physician-scientist in the biological and biomedical sciences in the many scientific disciplines that HHMI supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant research should fall within the broad biological/biomedical disciplines that HHMI supports (no exhaustive list on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment requirement (accepted postdoctoral position)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must have been accepted to join a laboratory as a postdoctoral researcher, led by a tenured or tenure-track faculty member at an eligible institution in the US, including Puerto Rico, at the time of the application deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptance to a specific lab and that the lab is led by tenured or tenure-track faculty at an eligible US institution (including Puerto Rico) is a precondition for application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effort commitment (75% research)
rubrics_metrics.description: You will commit 75% of your total effort to research in a postdoctoral training position by the grant start date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must plan to devote the majority of their time (three-quarters) to research activity when the grant begins; this is a concrete eligibility/participation requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum postdoctoral training duration
rubrics_metrics.description: You will commit to a minimum of two years of postdoctoral training in this position after the grant start date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awardees are expected to remain in the funded postdoctoral position for at least two years following the grant start.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Hold a PhD and/or MD (or equivalent) which is conferred by the start of the grant term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The required terminal degree must be awarded (conferred) by the time the fellowship begins.

rubrics_metrics.name: International applicant eligibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program accepts applicants who are international (non-U.S.-citizens), provided other eligibility conditions (e.g., accepted to a US institution lab) are met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline / deadline window
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications are expected during the winter quarter; applicants should plan around this submission window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program structure / transition to Freeman Hrabowski Scholars
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the new structure, Hanna Gray Fellows will receive up to two years of postdoctoral support, and up to ten years of faculty support as Freeman Hrabowski Scholars. Beginning in 2026, postdoctoral researchers interested in pursuing faculty positions will apply as part of the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program, and, if selected, will become Hanna Gray Fellows while postdocs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how postdoctoral support and later faculty support are structured and that application pathways change beginning 2026 (apply via Freeman Hrabowski Scholars for postdoc-to-faculty track).
